messages:
emily.w: Heads up — runtime 2.3 auto-unpin is scheduled tomorrow at 02:00 UTC per pin-policy, but we have a hotfix that depends on the 2.3 runtime. Can we carve an exception or delay the unpin for affected models? Affected: redwood/gpt3a-q and redwood/llama2-q. cc @sophie @raj

deploy-bot: Reminder: Unpin event scheduled: runtime-2.3 unpin at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z. No active pin exceptions found. To add exception run: `deploybot add-pin-exception --runtime runtime-2.3 --until 2026-03-25T08:00Z --reason "hotfix"`

raj: We validated the hotfix on canary with runtime-2.3 kernel patch. If the unpin proceeds it will break binary compatibility (kv-cache layout change). We need ~24h runway to promote canary -> stable.

sophie: Agreed. Prefer model-level pins rather than a platform-wide delay if possible — less blast radius. Can we pin only the two model IDs for 24h?

mike: Model-level pinning is fine from infra side, but ops will reserve capacity. @oncall-bot what does a pin-exception imply for capacity?

oncall-bot: Ops note: adding pin-exception will reserve approximately 1 p4d-equivalent for 24h in the runtime-2.3 pool for these models. Confirm before proceeding.

emily.w: We can't reserve for everyone. Proposal: create a short model-level pin-exception for the two model IDs and delay the global unpin by 6h as a fallback only if the pin PR misses review.

raj: +1 for model-level pin. I'll open the PR to add these entries to the pinlist: `redwood/gpt3a-q:v1` and `redwood/llama2-q:2026-03`. Will include smoke-tests.

sophie: Timeline check: if PR merged by 21:00 UTC today we can proceed with canary->stable and avoid impacting other customers. If not, we should abort this hotfix and target next change window.

deploy-bot: Action required: create PR with branch `pin-exception/1850001234` and run `./scripts/pinlist-validate.sh`. I will auto-merge on CI passing and `ci/pinlist` status green.

mike: I'll queue a quick review. @raj please add a short release-note blurb: 'Temporary model-level pin to runtime-2.3 for hotfix XYZ — scheduled unpin 2026-03-25T08:00Z; will remove if not needed.'

raj: Added blurb and smoke-tests. Also adding a canary-guard config: ```json
{
  "canary_pct": 10,
  "watchdog": true
}
```

sophie: Please also notify Support and CS so they can prepare customer-facing messaging if we extend the pin.

emily.w: I'll post a short note in #announcements and ping CS. If anyone objects to the model-level pin now speak up.

mike: No objections from infra. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Update: Pin-exception PR merged (branch pin-exception/1850001234). CI green. Model-level pins applied for redwood/gpt3a-q:v1 and redwood/llama2-q:2026-03. Global unpin remains scheduled but those models are excluded. Unpin will run for other models at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z; excluded models scheduled to be unpinned at 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z unless extended.

emily.w: Thanks all — keep an eye on canary metrics, and we'll reconvene post-rollout.
